<a id="active"></a>
## 🟢 획득 가능

기준 수치는 커뮤니티 관찰 결과입니다. 설정을 켜면 비공개 기여도 계산될 수 있습니다.

<a id="starstruck"></a>
### Starstruck

<img src="../assets/badges/starstruck-default.png" width="96" alt="Starstruck">

**별 16개**에 도달한 저장소를 만드세요. 상위 등급은 해당 저장소의 별 수에 따릅니다.

**등급:** 16 → 128 → 512 → 4096 (저장소 별).

[실제 사례](https://github.com/torvalds?achievement=starstruck&tab=achievements) · [S21](https://github.com/torvalds?achievement=starstruck&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="pull-shark"></a>
### Pull Shark

<img src="../assets/badges/pull-shark-default.png" width="96" alt="Pull Shark">

작성한 **pull request 2개가 병합**되어야 합니다.

**등급:** 2 → 16 → 128 → 1024 (작성한 병합 PR).

[실제 사례](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=pull-shark&tab=achievements) · [S22](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=pull-shark&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="pair-extraordinaire"></a>
### Pair Extraordinaire

<img src="../assets/badges/pair-extraordinaire-default.png" width="96" alt="Pair Extraordinaire">

**병합된 PR 1개**의 커밋을 공동 작성하고 올바른 `Co-authored-by`를 사용하세요.

**등급:** 1 → 10 → 24 → 48 (공동 작성한 병합 PR).

[실제 사례](https://github.com/Rongronggg9?achievement=pair-extraordinaire&tab=achievements) · [S23](https://github.com/Rongronggg9?achievement=pair-extraordinaire&tab=achievements) · [S18](https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/committing-changes-to-your-project/creating-and-editing-commits/creating-a-commit-with-multiple-authors) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="galaxy-brain"></a>
### Galaxy Brain

<img src="../assets/badges/galaxy-brain-default.png" width="96" alt="Galaxy Brain">

Discussions에서 **답변 2개가 채택**되어야 합니다. `github.com/orgs/community`는 2024-02-06부터 지급하지 않습니다.

**등급:** 2 → 8 → 16 → 32 (채택된 답변).

[실제 사례](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=galaxy-brain&tab=achievements) · [S24](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=galaxy-brain&tab=achievements) · [S06](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/106536) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="quickdraw"></a>
### Quickdraw

<img src="../assets/badges/quickdraw-default.png" width="96" alt="Quickdraw">

issue나 PR을 만든 뒤 **5분 이내에** 닫으세요.

[실제 사례](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=quickdraw&tab=achievements) · [S25](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=quickdraw&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="yolo"></a>
### YOLO

<img src="../assets/badges/yolo-default.png" width="96" alt="YOLO">

자신의 PR을 **코드 리뷰 없이** 병합하세요. 상세 공식 규칙은 공개되지 않았습니다.

[실제 사례](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=yolo&tab=achievements) · [S26](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=yolo&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="public-sponsor"></a>
### Public Sponsor

<img src="../assets/badges/public-sponsor-default.png" width="96" alt="Public Sponsor">

**GitHub Sponsors**로 개발자나 조직을 공개 후원하세요.

[실제 사례](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=public-sponsor&tab=achievements) · [S27](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=public-sponsor&tab=achievements) · [S19](https://github.com/sponsors) · [S02](https://github.blog/news-insights/company-news/open-source-goes-to-mars/)

<a id="retired"></a>
## 🕰️ 과거 업적

행사가 종료되었습니다. 기존 보상은 남을 수 있지만 새 기여로는 획득할 수 없습니다.

<a id="arctic-code-vault-contributor"></a>
### Arctic Code Vault Contributor

<img src="../assets/badges/arctic-code-vault-contributor-default.png" width="96" alt="Arctic Code Vault Contributor">

**2020-02-02 Arctic Code Vault 스냅샷**에 포함된 적격 저장소에 기여했습니다. 행사는 종료되었습니다.

[실제 사례](https://github.com/JakubOleksy?achievement=arctic-code-vault-contributor&tab=achievements) · [S04](https://github.blog/open-source/maintainers/the-arctic-code-vault-starts-production-and-your-open-source-projects-are-being-archived/) · [S05](https://archiveprogram.github.com/)

<a id="mars-2020-contributor"></a>
### Mars 2020 Contributor

<img src="../assets/badges/mars-2020-contributor-default.png" width="96" alt="Mars 2020 Contributor">

**NASA/JPL Ingenuity**가 사용한 특정 프로젝트 버전에 커밋을 작성했습니다. 행사는 종료되었습니다.

[실제 사례](https://github.com/torvalds?achievement=mars-2020-contributor&tab=achievements) · [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) · [S02](https://github.blog/news-insights/company-news/open-source-goes-to-mars/)

<a id="experimental"></a>
## 🧪 실험 중 / 비활성화

GitHub는 2026년 3월 재활성화가 실수였다고 확인했습니다. 공개 출시일은 발표하지 않았습니다.

<a id="heart-on-your-sleeve"></a>
### Heart On Your Sleeve

<img src="../assets/badges/heart-on-your-sleeve-default.png" width="96" alt="Heart On Your Sleeve">

❤️ 반응과 관련된 실험입니다. 2026년 3월 잘못된 활성화는 취소되었으며 현재 획득 방법은 확인되지 않았습니다.

[S07](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/190746) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="open-sourcerer"></a>
### Open Sourcerer

<img src="../assets/badges/open-sourcerer-default.png" width="96" alt="Open Sourcerer">

여러 공개 저장소의 병합 PR과 관련된 실험입니다. 정확한 규칙은 공개되지 않았습니다.

[S07](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/190746) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

## 🥇 등급

| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| [Starstruck](#starstruck) | 저장소 별 | 16 | 128 | 512 | 4096 |
| [Pull Shark](#pull-shark) | 작성한 병합 PR | 2 | 16 | 128 | 1024 |
| [Pair Extraordinaire](#pair-extraordinaire) | 공동 작성한 병합 PR | 1 | 10 | 24 | 48 |
| [Galaxy Brain](#galaxy-brain) | 채택된 답변 | 2 | 8 | 16 | 32 |

<a id="highlights"></a>
## ✨ 프로필 표시

Highlights는 업적과 별개인 프로그램 및 계정 표시이며 제공 여부는 프로그램에 달려 있습니다.

| 이름 | 상태 | 조건 | 출처 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Pro** | 획득 가능 | GitHub Pro를 사용하세요. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **Developer Program Member** | 획득 가능 | Developer Program에 참여하여 GitHub API로 앱을 만드세요. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **Security Bug Bounty Hunter** | 획득 가능 | Bug Bounty 프로그램에서 인정되는 GitHub 취약점을 보고하세요. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) · [S20](https://bounty.github.com/) |
| **GitHub Campus Expert** | 획득 가능 | GitHub Campus Experts에 참여하세요. 현재 신청 규칙을 확인하세요. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **Security Advisory Credit** | 획득 가능 | GitHub Advisory Database에서 승인된 보안 권고에 기여 인정을 받으세요. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **GitHub Star** | 획득 가능 | GitHub Stars에 선정되어야 합니다. 저장소 별 수만으로는 얻을 수 없습니다. | [S16](https://stars.github.com/) |
| **Discussion answered** | 과거 업적 | 채택된 답변을 나타내던 과거 표시입니다. 2022년에 Galaxy Brain으로 대체되었다는 보고가 있었습니다. | [S14](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/31629) |

### Proxima 사례

스크린샷과 카드가 일치합니다. Pioneer: M0 시제품 기여, Staffshipper: M8 인스턴스 배포, Staffuser: 팀 참여.

| 업적 | 계정 | UTC |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Proxima Pioneer](https://github.com/JakubOleksy?achievement=proxima-pioneer&tab=achievements) | @JakubOleksy | 2023-06-01T17:34:35Z |
| [Proxima Staffshipper](https://github.com/JakubOleksy?achievement=proxima-staffshipper&tab=achievements) | @JakubOleksy | 2024-08-21T22:28:27Z |
| [Proxima Staffuser](https://github.com/timrogers?achievement=proxima-staffuser&tab=achievements) | @timrogers | 2023-08-16T18:28:07Z |

“inaccessible”은 해당 이벤트에 접근할 권한이 없다는 뜻입니다. Staffshipper는 이미지에서 2024-08-22, UTC로 2024-08-21입니다.
